concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-3d-secure-rules-manager-android-v5]] - Android v5-routed Rules Manager guide for Control Panel ruleset policy, `verifyCard()` evaluation and Android custom-field handoff; 3DS authentication remains distinct from payment authorization, capture and settlement
warnings: The page's statement that Rules Manager is automatically enabled in Sandbox and Production must not be presented as proof that an individual merchant is enrolled in or compatibly configured for 3DS; existing collected authority says production accounts outside the EEA are not enrolled automatically.
Keep Control Panel policy configuration separate from Android client execution: `verifyCard()` evaluates the assigned ruleset and can carry overriding parameters or matching custom-field values.
Do not describe 3DS authentication or a Rules Manager action as payment authorization, processor approval, capture, settlement or guaranteed liability shift.
